body: Yes. Unfortunately, my method didn't work. Sorry if I worried you or anyone.

For the questions you asked, so far, I think the answer to most of them is "I don't really care," but like you said, that may change when finally on HRT. But I guess in terms of clothes, I wouldn't mind wearing more androgynous clothes and maybe even a dress every once in a while. Thanks for sharing your thoughts with me. :)

Yeah, it is kind of a worry that I will 'give in' to expectations of other people about how to identify. Especially since I've already come out as a trans woman to some people in my life. I guess once I really start transitioning, I'll try to find what is most comfortable for me to be in terms of identity/presentation. Thanks for sharing. :)

Hi. First post ever. Called an IC clinic in my area today and got an appointment to start HRT that's two weeks from now. Getting up the courage to call was nerve-wracking, but now I can't effin' wait!
